description: The OSeMOSYS community publishes this generator to assemble interconnected electricity-system models for chosen countries or the globe. Python processing and a Snakemake workflow combine default or user-provided data with YAML choices for generation, transmission, storage and policy. The current documentation permits model years from 2015 to 2100 and representative-day resolutions from one annual timeslice to 288 timeslices per year. Source is freely available on GitHub under its current AGPL-3.0 licence; the 2022 article states MIT for the earlier release. The workflow builds models for model-osemosys and documents GLPK with CBC, CPLEX or Gurobi for solving. It can support capacity expansion and transition scenarios. A caveat is that current README and documentation country totals differ, and aggregation can hide local constraints. Installation is tested on Unix, with WSL suggested for Windows. Input quality and solver terms remain separate considerations. No workflow or optimisation was executed.
